keywords: 沙盒智能钱包 ERC 合并
区块已死 blob 万岁
EU 数字身份选用 Noir
WhatsApp 私密处理 TEE 审计
summary: PowerStream3604 的沙盒智能钱包 ERC（ERC-8199）合并。ethresear.ch 发表区块已死、blob 万岁，nero_eth 解释 EIP-8142 把执行 payload 放进 blob 后验证者只需采样。EU 数字身份钱包选用 Noir 构建 ZK 身份应用。trailofbits 披露审计 WhatsApp 私密处理 TEE 时发现 8 个高危问题。

items.note_en: (PowerStream3604), merged after submission on March 19, defining sandboxed wallet interfaces for secure agent automation; EIP-8130: fix sentinel addresses (chunter-cb), submitted.

keywords_en: Blocks Are Dead Long Live Blobs
summary_en: PowerStream3604's Sandboxed Smart Wallet ERC (ERC-8199) merged. ethresear.ch published Blocks Are Dead. Long Live Blobs, and nero_eth explained that with EIP-8142 putting execution payloads in blobs, validators only need to sample. The EU digital identity wallet picked Noir for its ZK identity app. trailofbits disclosed 8 high severity issues found auditing WhatsApp's Private Processing TEEs.
